{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_test_orders = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA test orders
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute average revenue per order by channel
grouped = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().round(2)

# Compute the number of completed orders in each channel after cleaning
total_orders_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel').size()

# Print all required values
print(f'Average revenue per completed order in email channel: {grouped["email"]}')
print(f'Average revenue per completed order in paid_search channel: {grouped["paid_search"]}')
print(f'Total completed orders in email channel: {total_orders_by_channel["email"]}')
print(f'Total completed orders in paid_search channel: {total_orders_by_channel["paid_search"]}')
print(f'Total completed orders after removing refunded and QA orders: {len(df_clean)}')"}
